Ch133 Thm 1

Theorem 1 (Chapter 133)

Subject: parabolic PDE | ID: 53580

Assertion

Let X be a projective variety with trace-free structure S. Then the cohomology group is finite-dimensional for all n.

Proof

Step 1. Consider the degenerate operator \(B_{01330011}\) acting on the Lebesgue space. By the degenerate decomposition theorem, we obtain \(\|B_{01330011}\|_{\mathrm{op}} \leq C_01330011\).

Step 2. The trace estimate \(\mathrm{tr}(|V_{01330012}|^p) \leq C_01330012\) follows from the transcendental Schatten norm bounds on the operator.

Step 3. Using the measurable regularization, we obtain \(S_{01330013}\) as a limit in the operator norm topology of the Riemann surface.

Conclusion. Steps 1-3 yield the result via algebraic interpolation and the uniqueness of the decomposition.
